title: Quilted and deep-buttoned fabric
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of quilted fabric: diamond, square or channel quilting with puffed panels, stitched seams, crinkles and a fine weave, or deep-buttoned tufting. Use for bedspreads, puffer jackets, moving blankets, padded walls, headboards and Chesterfield sofas.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python quilted_fabric.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.meaning: 0 diamond quilting (two diagonal seam families), 1 square grid, 2 horizontal channels.

parameters.name: cells
parameters.meaning: Quilted panels across the tile width (diamonds, squares, or for channels the channel count down the tile).

parameters.name: aspect
parameters.meaning: Panels down the tile per panel across; above 1 the diamonds are taller than wide.

parameters.name: puff
parameters.meaning: How full the panels are between the seams.

parameters.name: stitches
parameters.meaning: Stitches along one panel edge; 0 hides the seams' stitching (tufting folds).

parameters.name: buttons
parameters.meaning: Size of the buttons pulled deep into the seam crossings, as in deep-buttoned upholstery.

parameters.name: wrinkles
parameters.meaning: Crinkles of the fabric gathered near the seams.

parameters.name: sheen
parameters.meaning: Gloss of taut panel tops: 0 matte cotton, 1 shiny nylon or satin.

parameters.name: weave
parameters.meaning: Fine woven texture of the cover fabric.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Cream cotton bedspread in diamond quilting with visible stitches.

presets.name: puffer_channel
presets.description: Black nylon puffer-jacket channels, glossy and crinkled.

presets.name: square_satin
presets.description: Blush satin in a square grid with fine stitching.

presets.name: chesterfield
presets.description: Deep-buttoned oxblood leather tufting: full diamonds, buttons, no stitches.

presets.name: moving_blanket
presets.description: Navy workwear quilting: small diamonds with contrast stitching.

limits: Panels are pillow profiles between straight seam lines, not cloth simulation: there is no drape, gathering or sagging, and tufting folds follow the seams instead of radiating from each button. Diamonds keep whole panel counts across and down the tile, so the aspect is quantized. Stitches are dashes in the seam groove; thread twist is not modelled. The weave is a fine cosine grid that fades out when it would be finer than a few pixels. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Seam lines as integer phase families n_u u + n_v v = k on the torus
Pillow height as a product of rounded profiles of the distance to each seam family
Stitch dashes from the phase of the crossing seam family
Buttons as domes in recesses at seam crossings
Ridged noise crinkles weighted by closeness to the seams
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
